name: MK-677
effects: Orally active non-peptide ghrelin mimetic — activates GHS-R1a to stimulate GH and IGF-1 release
Once-daily dosing due to ~24h half-life; raises GH and IGF-1 dose-dependently
Improves sleep quality and REM sleep; promotes lean mass and reduces fat mass over months
Significant appetite stimulation — hunger is the most common complaint
Fluid retention, increased fasting glucose, insulin resistance with chronic use — monitor metabolic panel
Lethargy and increased blood pressure at higher doses (50 mg)
Phase 2b trials for muscle wasting (elderly, hip fracture); not approved by FDA
Often mislabeled as a SARM — it is NOT; it is a ghrelin receptor agonist (small molecule)
